C-PUBLIC-REPOSITORY-HYGIENE.Name: Forward-only public repository hygiene
C-PUBLIC-REPOSITORY-HYGIENE.ApprovalBasis: Owner approval in chat on 2026-10-24 to proceed with the reviewed forward-only plan and parallelize where safe, without history rewriting, release deletion, or release authorization.
C-PUBLIC-REPOSITORY-HYGIENE.Summary: Move durable engineering rules into contributor-facing documentation, keep a small neutral repository router, retire public machine-specific review implementation, preserve deterministic publication checks, remove an exact set of obsolete current-tree artifacts, repair their live documentation references, and neutralize personal QA attribution in live source and verification text.
C-PUBLIC-REPOSITORY-HYGIENE.Problem: The current public tree mixes portable engineering policy with workstation-specific review mechanics, obsolete QA and generated image artifacts, a process-only GRACE projection, and personal QA attribution. Rewriting Git history would damage release and acceptance evidence without improving the current product tree.

Goals.Goal: Make CONTRIBUTING.md, docs/engineering-protocol.md and docs/release-process.md the canonical public engineering and release policy while keeping AGENTS.md as a short neutral router.
Keep Gitleaks, deterministic content/path/ref checks, exact candidate identity and hook installation public; move any additional private review implementation outside the repository.
Remove only the approved obsolete QA, handoff and generated screenshot paths from the current tree and prevent their accidental reintroduction.
Retire the M-901..M-906 process-only projection and its V-M/DF counterparts after preserving portable rules in the new engineering protocol.
Replace personal QA attribution in live source, tests and current verification with behavior-specific Windows QA wording.

Constraints.Constraint: Execute forward only: do not rewrite Git history, update or delete tags/releases, change product versions, authorize a release, or edit release-train and acceptance evidence; narrow protocol-link and operator-message corrections are allowed.
Preserve docs/*.xml, docs/migrations/** and .grace/changes/archive/** byte-for-byte as historical provenance.
Preserve authored work/** designs, docs/assets/readme/** release screenshots, runtime behavior and product-localization exceptions.
Use exact path removals and ignores; no broad pattern may hide authored design or release evidence.
Because existing approved active plans already overlap, implementation writes and durable reconciliation are sequential even though read-only audits ran in parallel.

NonGoals.NonGoal: History sanitization, cached-object removal, fork coordination, commit-message rewriting, or GitHub Support operations.
Changing release behavior, readiness, version surfaces, release notes, train membership or publication state.
Rewriting archived change bundles or append-only acceptance and release ledgers.
Removing generic product references to the AGENTS.md file format or changing localized fixtures and copy.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: AGENTS.md is a concise tracked router; CONTRIBUTING.md and docs/engineering-protocol.md contain the portable language, GRACE, semantic markup and verification rules; docs/release-process.md preserves the exact release runbook.

The public safety gate performs exact deterministic candidate, Gitleaks, path/content, binary, lane, attribution, ref and identity checks with no GPU, model endpoint, model prompt or override implementation.
The exact approved obsolete artifacts are absent and pinned by publication-privacy tests; work/** and docs/assets/readme/** remain present and governed.
CLAUDE.md and .env.local remain local-only, live operator references route to canonical public instructions, and current public text contains no owner absolute workspace path.
M-901..M-906, V-M-901..V-M-906, DF-901..DF-903 and the Phase-H process overlay are absent from current .grace projections while frozen provenance remains unchanged.
Live source, tests and current feature verification use behavior-specific Windows QA wording instead of personal attribution; archived C-15 evidence is unchanged.
Focused safety, privacy and affected renderer suites pass; GRACE final lint and status show no new errors.

VerificationIntent.ExpectedCommand: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests/security -p 'test_*.py'; npx vitest run tests/renderer/publication-privacy.test.js; npx vitest run tests/renderer/i18n/index.test.js tests/renderer/muya/htmlTagBr.test.js tests/renderer/platform-truth.test.js tests/renderer/store/preferences.test.ts; git diff --check fork/main plus untracked-file whitespace checks
VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: Deterministic safety receipts and markers, exact path-presence assertions, focused green suites, zero target/final GRACE errors, and a final diff proving release and historical-provenance paths were untouched.

Assumptions.Assumption: The already-merged release-conveyor and release-timing implementations are not being edited by this change; their still-active bundles are pre-existing GRACE lifecycle debt.
Additional owner-local review may be composed outside the repository but is not claimed or enforced by public source.
